dct:provenance:
This Croissant metadata was generated from the complete verified FlyBase Step 4 download manifest on 2026-07-17 without using GitHub or another public source-code repository.

Discovery recursively covered https://s3ftp.flybase.org/releases/current/, the current/latest FlyBase-hosted holdings for all 12 Drosophila species under https://s3ftp.flybase.org/genomes/, and the separately linked map-conversion workbook.

The 263 retained remote downloads are represented once each with their verified direct URL, exact byte count, and locally verified SHA-256 digest; three byte-identical collaborator mirrors had already been removed during Step 4.

Historical release siblings were not selected because the configured policy preferred the current FlyBase release and each species' active current holding. The selected FlyBase release is FB2026_02, released June 18, 2026; several non-melanogaster genome current holdings retain their older FlyBase release identifiers because FlyBase presents those paths as current.

All 13 true archives were inspected without extraction. Every regular member was represented as an inner cr:FileObject with its exact archive-relative path, byte count, computed SHA-256 digest, and a containedIn reference to the verified parent archive. This produced 121653 inner FileObjects (121496 raw nucleotide-sequence members and 157 PNG construct-map members); directory entries were not represented. Ordinary single-file .gz compression was not treated as a multi-member archive.

Archive members were not assigned synthetic RecordSet fields: .raw sequence members and PNG images have no source header or declared record schema, and inventing a content field for every member would not add source-supported structure. They remain individually and completely represented as inner FileObjects. 5 archive members were zero-byte files and remain represented because they are verifiable regular members of the source archives.

For tabular files, leading comments and preambles were scanned for exact tab-delimited schema lines. Datatype inference sampled no more than five aligned data rows per file. Exact observed header tokens were preserved without case, spacing, punctuation, or word-boundary normalization. 54 RecordSets used exact commented schema lines and 1 used exact in-band headers.

JSON RecordSets were generated only for top-level arrays of objects; exact JSON keys and JSONPath value locations were used, with no more than five records sampled for datatype inference. Files represented this way: ncRNA_genes_fb_2026_02.json.gz, scRNAseq_metadata_fb_2026_02.json.gz.

Nested JSON objects/arrays were omitted when they could not be represented as scalar field locations without inventing structure. GAF/GPI, GFF/GTF, XML, OBO, YAML, SQL, FASTA, checksum manifests, and spreadsheet structures were retained in distribution but were not assigned unsupported tabular fields where no exact source-resolvable Croissant column or JSONPath selector was available.

Archive-relative member contentUrl strings are exact paths inside their respective parents. Some species archives legitimately reuse member names such as scaffold_0.raw; those resources are uniquely identified by the pair (containedIn, contentUrl), as required for files in distinct archives. All 263 remote HTTP contentUrl values are globally unique.

The source states that different licensing and copyright terms may apply to data supplied by resources other than FlyBase. The dataset-level license records the canonical CC BY 4.0 license explicitly stated for annotations and data produced by FlyBase.

The configured source provides no single source-supported creation date for FlyBase as a whole. datePublished and dateModified therefore identify the exact current release date, 2026-06-18, rather than an inferred project-creation date.

STEP 8 AUDIT (2026-07-17): Checked 10 Croissant 1.1 required top-level fields; none were empty and no source value was invented. Scanned 121916 distribution contentUrl leaves. The 263 remote HTTP URLs were unique. Exact archive-relative member paths produced 14730 raw scalar repeat groups affecting 81541 entries, but every effective (containedIn, contentUrl) identity was unique; member paths were not falsified to force global scalar uniqueness. Re-inspected 13 true archives and verified 121653 regular members against exact paths, sizes, MIME types, and SHA-256 values; no structured/tabular inner files required RecordSets. Verified 644 Field sources with exact comment/preamble/in-band header or JSONPath evidence and at most 5 sampled data rows/records. Checked 121916 FileObjects for extension/signature/MIME agreement. Checked 263 remote URLs with redirects; final status breakdown was {200: 263}, with 0 minimal-GET retries, 0 authentication-related responses, and 0 removals. GeoCoordinates review found 15 name candidates in 7 RecordSets, all referring to genomic, cytogenetic, regulatory, or ambiguous locations rather than coherent geographic places; no GeoCoordinates field was forced.
